name: olai-plugin-git
//name: UNSCOPED, like every other row. `@olai/*` is the scope for the packages that ARE olai; this one is a plugin the loader mounts by name off a row in `packages/bundle/olai.yml`. The directory is `packages/plugins/git` and the package name is `olai-plugin-git`.
//exports: SIX doors. `./wire` is the member declarations: the two cells and three procedures, no UI runtime and no subprocess. `./server` is everything that runs in a server process — the plumbing, what is waiting, the quiet-window loop — and it is the module the row names. `./browser` is the pill, the phone banner and the commit panel, registered into the app's slots. The ROOT is the wire identity. `./testids` is names only. `./all.css` is the sheet. `./testlib` is a real repository for the packages that still test against one without becoming this plugin.
//devDependencies: @olai/surface for its `./testlib` door ONLY — the schema walk that holds this cell's `arrayKey` declaration honest (src/wire.test.ts). Deliberately not a runtime dependency: surface sits ABOVE the plugin packages, so a real dependency here would be the cycle the composition is shaped to make unrepresentable. @olai/ops is the same door the other way: pending tests drive the write gate through the ledger this row offers.
